reason: Independent PASS2 resolves the legal/operator boundary behind the current Moda re- Madrid network. Current Cáritas material lists eight Madrid-area second-hand clothing shops and direct Textil Empleo contact. Registry-derived BORME data identifies TEXTIL EMPLEO SL, CIF B88164322, Madrid Mercantile sheet M-677332, active 2026 appointments and an object including textile recycling and retail/wholesale sale. The operation is verified professional second-hand retail, but no current item-level remote second-hand apparel catalogue, direct online checkout or ordinary delivery to Spain was established, so it is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than ELIGIBLE.
